# WorldStepperState

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/view/world_stepper.h`](../../../src/view/world_stepper.h) · Described in `data/view.json`

Where the drawn worlds are between their last two ticks, and the Worlds panel state.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `alpha` | `double` | accumulator / h after this frame's ticks: interpolation factor between PhysicsPose prev and current (1 when paused) |
| `h` | `double` | fixed tick of world 0 (WorldClock::dt), 1/60 s by default |
| `paused` | `bool` | Pause checkbox |
| `step_once` | `bool` | Step button: one tick while paused |
| `ticks` | `uint64_t` | ticks stepped since start |

## Notes

Emplaced by WorldStepper in preinit; read by WorldView, SphereView, VRRoller, DesktopRoller (all treat it as optional, alpha 1 without).

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: DesktopRoller, SphereView, VRRoller, WorldView. Written by: WorldStepper. Created by: WorldStepper. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [DesktopRoller](../systems/DesktopRoller.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | alpha |
| [SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | alpha: drawn where WorldView draws it |
| [VRRoller](../systems/VRRoller.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | alpha |
| [WorldStepper](../systems/WorldStepper.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create** | preinit (emplace), tick | h from world 0's clock, paused / step_once from the panel, ticks, alpha = accumulator / h (1 when paused) |
| [WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | alpha between the last two ticks (1 without it) |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[DesktopRoller](../systems/DesktopRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Sphere roller"; collapses "Dynamical", "Worlds" and "Frame time" on first use.
  - Five host entities for the markers, destroyed in finish.
- **[VRRoller](../systems/VRRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[WorldStepper](../systems/WorldStepper.md)**
  - Runs every world's fixed systems (physics, agents, ...) on the main thread, sequentially (no executor passed to Worlds::step).
  - Frame dt is clamped to 0.25 s; when more than h is left after 8 ticks the remaining time is dropped (no spiral).
  - ImGui window "Worlds" (world count, tick, h, Pause checkbox, Step button).
- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
